history.summary: A new (2024) 3BR compact at 861 sqft, $1.5M, in D23 Bukit Panjang served by Phoenix LRT (650m, not MRT). $1,742 PSF is ~8% under the $1,887 URA median, and the $1.5M quantum is liquid, but the 5.99%/yr appreciation carries a new-launch bias flag and the only rail is the LRT feeder.
history.rating_rationale: Positives: low $1.5M quantum (deep buyer pool), brand-new 2024 build, $1,742 PSF ~8% below URA median $1,887, and a 5.99%/yr rate. But that rate is flagged has_new_launch_bias=true with no resale-only counterpart and only 68 txns, so it is inflated by developer pricing and should be discounted toward the OCR ~3.7% baseline. D23 Bukit Panjang is OCR with only LRT (BP5, 650m) feeding to the DTL — weaker connectivity than MRT-fronting peers. An 861 sqft 3BR is also tight, limiting family appeal. Fairly priced but no standout catalyst.
red_flags: 5.99%/yr rate flagged new-launch biased with no resale-only basis — likely overstated
Only LRT access (Phoenix BP5, 650m); no direct MRT, weaker D23 connectivity
861 sqft is cramped for a 3BR — compromises family-buyer resale appeal
catalysts: Brand-new 2024 completion — minimal maintenance, modern layout
$1.5M quantum sits in the deep-resale band
Priced ~8% below URA project median PSF
